shaper.name: symmetric
shaper.why: Rococo ornament is a mirrored plan around an axis; a three-tier parterre mirrored across the screen's vertical puts the bird at its head and gives the stair the long diagonal of the drawing's rising S-curve, the way a volute crowns a cartouche.

surface_mix.why: Rings of cream gravel and clipped celadon lawn around the figure echo the concentric volute at the wing joint; pale marble for the landings, a touch of rose gravel.

cliff_treatment.why: Blush plaster over gilt-ochre footings: the colours of a rococo boiserie, stepped like its mouldings.

concept.name: aspect-volute
concept.fragment: Round 5 reading authored by the build agent from pipeline/seed/analysis/forest.json and the drawing itself, without the analyzer (Gemini returns 402). One aspect of the charcoal drawing, "volute", becomes the place; the shaper, palette, lighting, props and the figure's pose are argued from that aspect alone. It must not repeat the round-4 forest readings (ash basin with soot trunks, taproot knoll with charred boles, birch spiral) or their shapers (basin, mound, spiral).
